lines.text: Eagerworks AI Studio turns AI capabilities into real products, workflows and measurable outcomes.
Some problems need more than an API call.
For robotics, we build the vision stack itself: hand and face detection, camera and wrist tracking, and custom datasets.
Then we train and benchmark every model, until the data is ready to teach a robot.
Computer vision turns a camera into a live source of operational data.
On a tractor, it detects, counts and measures every plant, and maps exactly where each one is.
On the packing line, every pumpkin gets its own ID the moment it appears, and keeps it until it's counted.
Alongside our client work, we're building products of our own.
Like a vision system for packing lines that runs on a single overhead camera.
It detects every apple in every crate, gives each one its own ID, and keeps a running count.
Each apple is sized and graded for ripeness as it crosses the line, so the team sees quality live.
We're not just another AI studio.
We start by listening: to your people, your users, and the problem behind the request.
